Well, sure say we were wondering what got them up in a jiffy like that, so naturally we went out to do a bit of Espy--- espy no -- espy knowledge."

"some fellow named Whitmore. Penny says he is a writer. But I don't know I haven't right hea-"

"Ohh. Alryt thanks for the lead. By-"
"Sirus, Sirius! You told you'd buy us a new pair of clothes the next time we inform you. I quite like a batman shirt we saw displayed on the Maris' donwtown and Penny-"
"I'll buy you all you want when I'm free Pip. Now let me be. Once I comeback, I promise."
